name: Concord Control Systems Ltd
title: Concord Control Systems Ltd - 543619 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Concord reports FY26 revenue INR 210.47 crore, EBITDA INR 62.1 crore and a INR 697 crore order book (3.3x revenue), but receivables and short-term debt rose sharply and management gave no capacity, utilisation or cash-conversion numbers.

triggers.label: Receivables up sharply, no cash conversion
triggers.quote: Trade receivables have increased significantly during the year.

triggers.label: Working capital rise expected to persist
triggers.quote: So, we should expect this type of working capital going forward also, right?

triggers.label: Fusion revenue timing slipped
triggers.quote: So I hope this year will be a revenue contributing year as well.

triggers.label: Order book INR 697 crore, 3.3x revenue
triggers.quote: our executable order book as of 31 March , 2026 stands at approximately INR 697 crores.

guidance.value: about INR 200 crore at full scale

red_flags.label: Receivables and short-term debt rising; no peak debt guidance
red_flags.quote: Very difficult to comment today, because in the Q1, we will always have higher receivables coming from our clients.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow timing unanswered
red_flags.quote: So, there's no liquidity challenge at all?

red_flags.label: Fusion turnaround with no FY26 revenue disclosed
Evasive answers on Kavach tender and loco count
red_flags.quote: We'll come back to you with the exact numbers.

evasions.topic: Operating cash flow and when working capital turns positive
evasions.quote: There is absolutely no issue in railway payments. It's just a cycle and a process.
We'll come back to you with the exact numbers.
